skills.description: Transcribe a local video file or online video URL (Bilibili / YouTube, etc.) into a structured Markdown document with keyframe screenshots, full audio transcription (ASR), on-screen text extraction (OCR), semantic segmentation, enhanced code blocks, and a summary. Use when the user asks to "转录视频 / 把这个视频转成文字 / 视频全文转录 / 提取视频中的文字和图片 / 把这节课做成文档" or wants a tutorial / course / talk video turned into readable, searchable Markdown. Body text follows a refined note style (chapter overview + step-wise concise narration, NOT verbatim ASR transcription); the author's original code is preserved verbatim with any optimization suggestions as separate comments.
